question.wording: Was this NOT paid (or charged to a credit card) in 2025, or is it a payment for care to be received in a later year?

options.label: Yes — not paid in 2025, or for future care
No — paid in 2025 for care already received

default.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Was this NOT paid (or charged to a credit card) in 2025, or is it a payment for care to be received in a later year?

citation.line: What Expenses Can You Include This Year?
citation.wording: You can include only the medical and dental expenses you paid this year but generally not payments for medical or dental care you will receive in a future year.
